sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000163-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Cedar Valley Physician Alliance 163 on March 14, 2026.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 2 rebate of 3%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Influenza share floor of 70%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: declined by the Customer.
